name: Mira Valk
desire: render faithfully and remain the neutral conduit she is sworn to be
need: to stop pretending the person in the middle is innocent of the outcome
fears: being the one whose tongue decides a man's fate
betraying the valley she left as a girl
contradictions: sworn to neutrality yet she softened one word on reflex
left the valley yet its dead are still hers
beliefs: a faithful rendering is a just one
the interpreter is a pane of glass the words pass through
knowledge: the hill dialect and its double senses
that the court trusts her as verbatim
that the case against the accused is thin
constraints: the sole interpreter of the dialect
she may not confer with a witness

lexicon: bare and plain in the dialect
syntax: the shape of a sentence weighed before it is said
